steps.code:
# Let's parse all notes to extract date and habit values.
import re

parsed_notes = []
for note in all_notes_data:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    title = note['title']
    date_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not date_match:
        print(f"Could not find date in title: {title}")
        continue
    date = date_match.group(1)
    
    # Parse content lines
    content = note['content']
    lines = content.split('\n')
    habits = []
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if ':' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = habit.strip()
            value = value.strip().lower()
            if value not in ('yes', 'no'):
                print(f"Unexpected value '{value}' for habit '{habit}' in note {note['note_id']}")
            habits.append((habit, value))
    parsed_notes.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits, 'note_id': note['note_id']})

# Print first few to verify
for p in parsed_notes[:3]:
    print(p)

# Fetch and parse all habit tracking notes
import re

parsed_data = []
for note in all_notes:
    detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=login_result["access_token"], note_id=note["note_id"])
    title = detail["title"]
    # Extract date from title like "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not m:
        continue
    date = m.group(1)
    content = detail["content"]
    lines = content.splitlines()
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line:
            key, val = line.split(':', 1)
            key = key.strip()
            val = val.strip().lower()
            if val in ('yes', 'no'):
                habits[key] = val
    parsed_data.append({"date": date, **habits})

# Print first few to verify
print(len(parsed_data))
print(parsed_data[0])
print(parsed_data[-1])

# Sort parsed_data by date descending
